meta.purpose: Merges spellings and legal names of one developer in the agency funding view (js/agency-funding.js). Keys are developerKey() of the printed name (js/agency-funding-model.js), which already ignores case, punctuation, a bracketed acronym and legal suffixes such as LLC or Inc. Each entry says why the names are one organisation.
